title: The Greatest Gift of Love
story:
A little boy carefully saved his pocket money for many months.

When his mother's birthday arrived, he bought her a small gift with everything he had saved.

The gift was simple, but his mother treasured it.

She wasn't impressed by its price.

She was touched by the love behind it.

True love is measured by sacrifice, not by cost.

God showed the greatest love the world has ever known.

He gave His one and only Son, Jesus Christ, so that we could have eternal life.

Jesus willingly came to earth, died on the cross for our sins, and rose again so that everyone who believes in Him can be saved.

No greater gift has ever been given.

God's love is freely offered to every person.

All we need to do is believe in His Son and receive the life He promises.
life_lesson: God's greatest expression of love was giving Jesus for our salvation. His gift of eternal life is available to everyone who believes.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for loving me so much that You gave Your only Son.

Thank You, Jesus, for willingly giving Your life to save me.

Help me to live each day in gratitude for Your amazing love.

May I share this Good News with others so they too may know You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What does God's gift of Jesus mean personally to you?

How has His love changed your life?

Who can you share the message of God's love with today?
verse: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
